name: agent-index-marketplace
description: Discover, download, and install collections from the agent-index marketplace. Manage your org’s installed collections and keep them up to date. v2.5.0: check-updates 2.4.0 gains contract-version-aware surfacing — adapter contract gaps that block installed collections are escalated to a top-of-report BLOCKER naming the driving collections; gaps without consequence remain a passive opportunity NOTE. Collections may declare requires_contract_version in collection.json; check-updates computes max across installed collections and compares against the local adapter’s contract_version. Lightweight-mode result gains contract_blockers[]. Closes idea contract-version-aware-update-surfacing. v2.4.0: check-updates gains an Available-to-Install section — surfaces capabilities present in installed collections that the running member hasn't picked up yet, mirroring org-setup's management-dashboard signal. v2.3.0: new `@ai:upgrade-collection` task closes bug 20260502-8d20ea22 — admins can now upgrade an already-installed marketplace collection in one verb (counterpart to `@ai:publish-updates --check-upstream` for infrastructure and `@ai:edit-org → Update Adapter Bundle` for filesystem adapters). Setup-responses preserved during upgrade. CHANGELOG entry written for member-side @ai:apply-updates consumption. v2.2.x: check-updates 'what to do' guidance + Step 2.6 binary surfacing. v2.1.x: extended adapter contract surfacing.
author: agent-index
